pages.title: A note for the counter
pages.body:
Welcome to Neon Undertow. The new customers, factions and shops join your normal playthrough; there is no activation key. Customers arrive through ordinary visits, so you will meet them over time.

Keep this little book cubby in your main shop or put it inside the Dossier to sort your collection. Double-click it to open, then activate a handbook to read. Use the book's index and page arrows. You can take a book out and move it like any other item.

pages.title: Keep the counter clear
pages.body:
The corner guide is off by default. If you prefer a shortcut, open Mods, select Neon Undertow, then Settings and turn on Show corner guide. The change takes effect immediately. Startup status is also available there.

The cubby accepts your owned books and paper documents, including vanilla handbooks. Recipe books still need to be bought or earned. Move a recipe book into its machine's INPUT when you want to craft. Keeping it in this cubby does not unlock production remotely.

Replacement Undertow guides and empty cubbies are sold on the Co-op's KITCHEN + BOOKS shelf.

pages.title: Your first evening
pages.body:
After closing, visit Quayside Canning Co-op using the travel menu. Buy a chopping board from KITCHEN + BOOKS, plus an apple and a cabbage from PRODUCE.

Back home, click the arrow at the bottom right of the shop, then click the worktop. Follow First meal in this cubby's Workshop Fieldbook. You do not need to fit a station just to open the kitchen. Keep your guides: their index lets you return to any lesson.

pages.title: People and factions
pages.body:
Open FACTIONS and use Next to find the new communities after the vanilla groups. Hover reputation milestones to see what they offer and what happens if your standing falls.

Open your shop and serve visitors normally. Neon Undertow adds regulars to the customer pools, including the Velvet Quay community and upper-class visitors. Story customers keep their original roles.

pages.title: After closing
pages.body:
Once the shop closes, use the normal travel/map menu to visit the night shops.

Quayside Canning Co-op stocks produce, cans, kitchen supplies and books. Its shelves are divided into SODA SUPPLIES, PRODUCE, KITCHEN + BOOKS and CELLAR. Finish a purchase or return the unbought item before changing shelves.

Stock renews daily. Your faction standing can affect offers and prices.

pages.title: Equipment and fixtures
pages.body:
Stormglass Depot Outlet carries storage and water equipment. Undertow Engineering supplies production modules, attachments and packaging pattern chips.

Glassmarket Counter & Fixture Stall stocks signs, lamps and bar equipment: a tool rail, measures, a mixing glass, shaker, blender, serving glass and a bartender's notebook. The tools are separate items; the rail is storage for them.

pages.title: Make room to work
pages.body:
Click the arrow at the bottom right of the shop to reach the back room. The worktop shares your front counter stock; click it to cook. Click the cabinet or a fitted machine to open it, and the door to return to the shop.

Joe Wild's BACK ROOM services add station bays, storage tiers and fitted equipment. Buy the actual machine before fitting it.

Keep this guide and the book cubby in the main area if that is where you prefer to read.

pages.title: Produce and cooking
pages.body:
Buy cooking tools and recipe books at Quayside Canning Co-op. Click the back-room worktop to open the kitchen. Fit tools in their top slots and charged cells in BATTERIES. Put ingredients, water and an optional fridge in INPUT. A fridge needs its own battery.

Choose a dish from your recipe books, then press Craft: the listed ingredients, water and power are consumed. Tools and books are kept. Heated recipes still need a galley or a heating plate; chilled recipes need a powered fridge.

For an unambiguous single-ingredient recipe, you can also drag the matching tool onto the ingredient.

pages.title: Canning and workshop supplies
pages.body:
Buy the Fizzworks Soda Canner at Stormglass Depot Outlet after hours.

Put the Fizzyworks recipe book in the canning machine input. For other production recipes, use the matching recipe manual and the game's item picker. Supply the listed ingredients, water, packaging and power. Tools and books are kept.

Soda accepts water above Basewater grade. Source water and container condition affect quality. Flavour ingredients are not dirty water.

To make empty metal packaging, use the native printer with a matching chip from Undertow Engineering, metal, the required modules and charged batteries.

pages.title: Waterworks
pages.body:
The Industrial Water Generator becomes available at Stormglass Depot from day 28 when you have a Grand Waterworks installed. Its list price is 12,500 credits.

Fit a charged cell. Overnight it generates and fills up to four native 2 L high-quality water bottles, using six power each: 24 for a full set. It needs no ingredient or empty-bottle input. Leave room in OUTPUT.

Starting traits do not grant this generator. Items left in older input or attachment slots stay retrievable. The Waterworks handbook explains the manual bottling equipment and its recipes.

pages.title: Cellar and bar
pages.body:
The Co-op's CELLAR shelf sells a Cellar Bench, Brewing Notes, bottles and culture. Its 76 recipes cover suitable fruits, grains, starch crops and infusions. Choose Ferment, Distill or Infuse and load one combination; batches take nights.

The CELLAR tab stores finished bottles. Use the native powered Age-Well rack for suitable wines, cider and perry. Bottled spirits do not mature merely by being stored.

At the bar, pour using ordinary inventory targeting. Measure portions, activate the mixing glass to stir or the shaker to shake, then pour into a bottle. Stir carbonated drinks. The blender extracts produce juices. Read the bartender's notebook for quantities and recipes.

pages.title: First meal: Apple Slaw
pages.body:
Fit a chopping board in its top kitchen slot. Put one apple and one cabbage in INPUT, then open COOK. Click Apple Slaw and collect it from OUTPUT. This starter recipe needs no water, battery or heating plate.

For other meals, read their recipe book. Fit the matching tool; supply any listed water and power. A heating plate or galley provides heat for a pan or saucepan, but does not replace the tool. A fridge needs its own battery.

pages.title: Your first bottled drink
pages.body:
Open the Manual Bottling Kit. Put the Undertow Bottling Handbook, matching concentrate, water at 99% purity or higher and an empty 350/500 mL can or 750 mL glass bottle in INPUT.

Choose a ready drink in the middle. It uses one concentrate, one container and that container's capacity in water. Collect the labelled drink from OUTPUT. The kit needs no power. Plastic water bottles are not soda packaging. Keep space for the result.

pages.title: Plant your first crop
pages.body:
These crops are genetically modified compact varieties bred for standard hydroponic growers. Even the fruit trees stay small.

Buy fruit or vegetable seed assortments from the Co-op's PRODUCE shelf. Open a packet and put one seed in the vanilla hydroponic unit's seed slot. Add a charged battery and a water container; use the plant analyser to check the crop's nutrient needs.

Growth uses the normal machine cycles, water and plant-health rules. Collect produce and returned seeds from OUTPUT. Healthy crops can yield large and huge produce, just like Nutrifruit. Keep seeds to plant the next generation.

The SEEDS shelf sells packs of three seeds of one crop. Select SEEDS again to switch between fruits and vegetables.

pages.title: Develop your own strains
pages.body:
Our crop seeds use the vanilla plant DNA system. Read the DNA Manipulator's instruction note. Put a compatible written trait disk in TRAIT DISK, a seed in TARGET and supply power. Check the operation and success chance before starting.

For extraction, use the BLANK DISK slot and read the displayed risks. Successful edits can change growth, yield, water demand or produce properties. Returned seeds inherit the parent's traits. Keep a spare strain: edits can fail, and incompatible traits remain restricted.

pages.title: Working the chemistry bench
pages.body: Buy compound cylinders from Glassmarket. Mix equal measures of the two named stocks with a little water in one cylinder. Try 2 mL of each and 1 mL of water. Heat until both stocks have reacted. Check the mixture with the composition spectrometer. For dry recipes use the evaporator, then select the product in the Chem Finisher. Cards give the minimum heat and the volume per pack.

pages.title: Clinic formulas
pages.body:
Bridge Tablet — Quiet Signal + Velvet Static
45 °C · 2 mL · dry

Seam Gel — Switchback + Low Tide
45 °C · 2 mL · may stay wet

Daybreak Injector — Mirror Salt + Redshift
65 °C · 4 mL · may stay wet

Clinic batches need at least 75% active and no residual euphoric, addictive or toxic liquid.

pages.title: Street formulas
pages.body:
Yardglass — Dock Chalk + Emberwake
65 °C · 2 mL · dry
Keep water in the cylinder and use LOW. A dry batch on HIGH can end the run.

Prism Chorus — Undertone + Glass Choir
65 °C · 3 mL · dry

Undertint — Lamplight + Night Ink
45 °C · 1.5 mL · dry

Street batches need at least 50% active. A narcotics buyer judges the finished batch by purity.

pages.title: Splitting a batch
pages.body: Make the first-stage mixture on the heating plate. Before drying or finishing it, split it into two cylinders. For each 6 mL of active compound use 6 mL of just one additive and leave at least 0.5 mL of extra water. Heat to 55 °C. Use fresh juice from the blender or clean milk from a nursing spotted rat. Two competing additives block that branch. Check the spectrometer before finishing.

pages.title: Yardglass safety
pages.body: Use water and low heat. A dry mix of Dock Chalk and Emberwake on high heat can explode. If the cylinder rattles, take it off or turn the plate down immediately. Once the countdown starts, the batch is lost and the explosion ends the run.

pages.title: Finding missing content
pages.body:
Enable Neon Undertow in Mods and restart the game. Check Startup status in its Settings. If Steam is still downloading an update, close the game and let it finish before reopening.

New factions are on the later FACTIONS pages. Customer options can disable future arrivals; settings marked Restart required need a restart. Night shops are reached after closing.

The corner shortcut is optional. Hiding it does not disable any content or remove your books.

pages.title: Existing saves
pages.body:
Neon Undertow runs independently and includes its own Cellar Bench and brewing recipes. Back up a save before changing its mod set.

The starter cubby is delivered once per playthrough when there is room on the main counter, including existing saves that have not received it. It does not refill after you move or sell its books. Your cubby contents and bookmarks use the normal item save system.

pages.title: If something goes wrong
pages.body:
If back-room cargo cannot load, saving is blocked to protect the original items. Return to the menu and report the problem.

For a bug report, include the game and mod versions, whether the save is new or existing, other enabled mods, and the steps that led to the problem. A screenshot helps. Startup failures are recorded in Player.log.

The guide explains the tools; it does not repair items, test liquids or skip recipe requirements.

pages.title: If the kitchen seems stuck
pages.body:
Click the back-room worktop and select COOK. The cabinet's FITTED STATION slot is not the cooking tool selector. Fit tools in the top slots; put ingredients in INPUT and leave OUTPUT space.

No recipes? Check the exact ingredients, tool, water, power and heating or chilling requirements. TOOL: Chopping Board with heat/work controls is the older interface, retained for an unfinished saved batch. Finish that batch to return to ready recipes. If still stuck, report your version and a full-window screenshot.
